note: Documented exceptions for the S-PERF budget gate. These cells breach the frozen C16 LCP good threshold (<= 2500 ms) because the /tasks table-view family (table, detail-open, search, bulk-select) is a known, separately-owned pre-existing bottleneck that renders ~3.1-3.3 s lab p75 on this host — measured in BOTH the recorded baseline and the recorded candidate (see artifacts/ux-v5-1/performance/{baseline,candidate}.json). They are NOT waived budget math: the surface lane owns the fix (T77) and S-PERF changes no application code. Waiving them HERE (never silently) is what lets `npm run perf:budget` be wired into the shared `npm run verify` without making it permanently red for every engineer (PERF-03). A waived cell is NOT a pass: it stays listed in the gate output and must be closed by the owning performance lane, after which its entry is removed. Regression-tier (baseline-relative) breaches on other cells are NOT listed here: a same-checkout re-run cannot evidence a code regression, so the gate classifies those as VARIANCE, not WAIVED.
